projects.title: AI Agency Automation CRM
projects.full_description: AI Agency Automation CRM is a full-stack AI-powered platform designed to streamline lead capture, management, analysis, and follow-up for modern agencies. The system supports both manual lead entry through the CRM dashboard and automated lead capture through Google Forms, Google Sheets, and n8n workflows. Leads are centralized in Supabase PostgreSQL and analyzed using AI to identify customer intent, lead quality, priority, potential value, recommended services, and next actions. The platform provides a centralized workspace for managing leads and AI-driven business insights.
projects.problem: Agencies often receive leads from different sources and manage them manually, making it difficult to maintain a centralized lead database, evaluate lead quality, understand customer intent, and determine the appropriate next action. This can result in delayed responses, inconsistent lead management, and missed business opportunities.
projects.solution: Developed a centralized AI-powered CRM that combines automated lead capture, database management, and AI-driven lead analysis. The system accepts leads through both manual dashboard entry and automated Google Forms and Google Sheets workflows using n8n. Leads are stored in Supabase PostgreSQL and analyzed using AI to provide actionable insights for prioritization and follow-up.
projects.features: Manual Lead Management, Automated Lead Capture, Google Forms Integration, Google Sheets Integration, n8n Workflow Automation, Supabase PostgreSQL Database, AI Lead Analysis, Lead Scoring, Customer Intent Detection, AI Summary, Recommended Services, Recommended Actions, Lead Priority, Proposal Management, Follow-up Management, CRM Dashboard, Analytics
projects.architecture: The platform uses Next.js and React for the frontend and application interface, with TypeScript for type safety. Supabase PostgreSQL provides centralized data storage. Manual leads are submitted directly through the CRM dashboard, while automated leads flow from Google Forms to Google Sheets and then through n8n workflow automation. n8n sends the processed lead data through a webhook/API layer into Supabase. AI processing analyzes lead information and generates customer intent, lead score, summary, priority, recommended services, and next actions. The application is deployed on Vercel and managed using GitHub.
projects.challenges: Implemented reliable lead ingestion from both manual dashboard entry and automated n8n workflows. Resolved Supabase database permission issues for authenticated users, including required INSERT and CRUD privileges for the leads table. Integrated AI analysis into the lead-management workflow while maintaining a centralized PostgreSQL data layer. Also implemented production deployment and verified the application through live dashboard testing.
projects.results: The platform provides a centralized workflow for capturing, storing, analyzing, and managing leads from both manual and automated sources. It demonstrates an end-to-end AI automation workflow that reduces manual lead-processing steps and provides actionable AI insights for prioritizing potential customers.

projects.title: VELAN SUPERMARKET — Retail Management Dashboard
projects.description: Business Dashboard for Sales, Inventory, Products, Customers & Performance Analytics
projects.full_description:
VELAN SUPERMARKET is a modern retail management platform designed to centralize supermarket operations into one dashboard. The system manages products, inventory, sales, purchasing, suppliers, customers, billing, and business performance.

The platform supports bill generation and role-based access for different users involved in supermarket operations. It provides dashboards, KPI cards, sales tracking, product management, inventory monitoring, customer management, purchasing, supplier management, billing, and business analytics.

The system uses React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, Recharts, Supabase, and PostgreSQL to provide a responsive and centralized business management experience.
projects.problem:
Supermarket operations involve multiple activities including product management, inventory, sales, purchasing, suppliers, customers, billing, and business performance monitoring.

Managing these activities across separate processes can make it difficult to maintain centralized information and monitor day-to-day business operations efficiently.

The project was developed to bring these core supermarket management activities into a centralized dashboard with organized business data and analytics.
projects.solution:
Developed a centralized retail management platform using React and Next.js with Supabase PostgreSQL for application data management.

The system organizes supermarket operations into dedicated management modules for products, inventory, sales, purchasing, suppliers, customers, billing, and business performance.

The dashboard provides KPI cards, sales tracking, interactive analytics, bill generation, and role-based access for different users. The responsive interface was built using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/UI, with Recharts used for business data visualization.

projects.title: Aura AI Personal Assistant
projects.description: AI-powered personal assistant with long-term memory, intelligent tools, web search, and conversational interaction.
projects.full_description:
AI Personal Assistant is a full-stack conversational AI application designed to provide personalized assistance through natural language interaction. The system combines Google Gemini AI with Supabase-backed long-term memory, server-side function calling, current-time tools, and web search capabilities.

The assistant can understand conversations, remember relevant user information, retrieve previously stored memories, and proactively use available tools when required. The application is built with Next.js and provides a modern SaaS-style chat interface with conversation history and persistent data.
projects.problem:
Traditional AI chat applications often treat every conversation as isolated. They may provide useful answers but lack persistent personal context, structured memory, and the ability to interact with external tools.

The goal of this project was to build a personal AI assistant that can maintain conversational context, remember useful information across sessions, and dynamically use tools to provide more useful and personalized responses.
projects.solution:
The solution uses a Next.js full-stack architecture with Google Gemini as the AI reasoning layer and Supabase as the persistent data layer.

A server-side API route manages conversations, retrieves relevant memories, injects those memories into the AI context, executes tool calls, and returns the final response to the client.

The architecture also separates AI logic, database access, and tool execution into dedicated modules, making the system easier to extend with additional capabilities.
projects.features: Persistent AI conversations, Long-term memory, Memory retrieval and context injection, Google Gemini integration, Server-side function calling, Current date and time tool, Web search capability, Supabase persistence, Conversation history, Responsive chat interface, Secure server-side API key handling, Vercel deployment
projects.architecture:
The frontend is built with Next.js and React. User messages are sent to the server through the /api/chat endpoint.

The server initializes the Supabase client, retrieves relevant memories, and injects the memory context into the Gemini model. When the model requests a tool, the server-side tool execution loop resolves and executes the requested function, sends the function response back to Gemini, and continues the conversation until the final response is generated.

Supabase provides persistent storage for conversations, messages, and long-term memories. Tavily provides web search capabilities when required. Environment variables are used to securely configure external services, and the application is deployed on Vercel.
projects.challenges: Implemented dynamic AI provider integration, resolved server-side Supabase client initialization, designed persistent memory retrieval and context injection, implemented Gemini function calling with a server-side execution loop, handled tool namespacing and function responses, preserved Gemini response content required for tool execution, separated tool execution from stored conversation messages, and configured production deployment with secure environment variables.
projects.results:
Successfully deployed a production-ready AI personal assistant with persistent conversation storage, long-term memory, AI tool execution, and web search capabilities.

The architecture provides a scalable foundation for extending the assistant with additional tools, automation workflows, and personalized AI capabilities.

projects.title: Dhiya Associates — Premium Electronics E-commerce Platform
projects.description: Premium Electronics E-commerce & Sales Service Platform
projects.full_description: Designed and developed a full-stack e-commerce website for Dhiya Associates, a premium electronics sales and service business. The platform was redesigned with a luxury visual system and structured product, service, contact, WhatsApp and business-location experiences. The implementation focused on responsive UI, reusable components, maintainable architecture, production deployment and a smooth customer journey across desktop and mobile.
projects.problem: The existing business website needed a complete modernization to represent the premium electronics showroom brand and improve the customer experience. The main challenges included outdated visual presentation, inconsistent responsive behavior, limited product and service discovery, weak contact conversion flow, and the need to clearly present sales, service and business-location information.
projects.solution: Rebuilt the website as a modern responsive e-commerce platform using Next.js and reusable React components. Introduced a premium visual design system, structured product and service sections, responsive layouts, WhatsApp conversion flows, business-location management, reusable settings infrastructure and production-ready deployment architecture. The implementation was integrated with the existing backend and database foundations instead of creating duplicate systems.
projects.features: Premium responsive e-commerce UI, Product browsing, Electronics categories, Sales and service sections, WhatsApp enquiry integration, Business contact information, Business location management, Responsive navigation, Mobile-first layouts, Animated UI interactions, Admin-managed settings, SEO-friendly page structure
projects.architecture: Built with Next.js and React using reusable component architecture. Backend functionality is exposed through REST API routes with shared service utilities. PostgreSQL/Supabase is used for persistent data and business settings. Shared configuration and settings services prevent duplicate data-management systems. The application is optimized for responsive rendering and deployed on Vercel for production hosting.
projects.challenges: Redesigned the existing interface without breaking existing functionality, integrated WhatsApp enquiry flows across the customer journey, implemented reusable business-location settings, resolved responsive layout issues across screen sizes, improved hero-section visual composition, maintained existing database architecture, and verified the production build and deployment workflow.
projects.results: Production-ready website successfully deployed for the client. Improved premium brand presentation, clearer product and service discovery, stronger WhatsApp enquiry flow, responsive customer experience across devices, and centralized business information management.
